schema.carrier: Golden-provider-owned decoded model handle, not a guest RW clump or raw serialized file pointer
schema.other_record_bytes: Opaque; no meaning, padding, raw guest-copy compatibility or full on-disk model format is inferred.

index_rules.Steam_target: sign-extend the low8bits of index: movzx edi,dl then movsx rax,dil before multiplying112
index_rules.NSO_witness: zero-extend the low8bits: index &255 before multiplying112
index_rules.qualification: These differ for128..255. Runtime contract targets Steam; do not silently use NSO unsigned semantics, invent bounds clamps or claim all assets have fewer than128 records.

active_path.rule: Replace named-key clump traversal with typed Golden metadata lookups and the recorded record schema. Do not merely inject numbers into old ASCII partitions or call the old user-data API with renamed strings.
active_path.gating: Golden skips records with placementID0, not records with assetID0. Preserve assetID0 when placementID is nonzero. Type-based named model/effect resolution and opaque provider handles remain Golden-aware dependencies.
active_path.entry_flags: Set bit1/value2 when flags has either sourcebit1 or sourcebit21. Set bit0/value1 iff animation_mode==1. Additional Golden flags: flagsbit0 adds value4; else flagsbit1 adds value8. Do not OR raw animation_mode into old flags, retain the old type0-only animation gate, truncate flags to8bits, or swap placement and asset IDs.

retired_user.rule: In Golden mode the retired lookup returns0 and performs NO flagsOut write. NSO ordinary code is exactly movx0,xzr;ret. Steam model-creation body positively removes the placement query/transform branch after model registration and still compares an unwritten stack slot. Do not invent flagsOut=0 or preserve PS2 named-key lookup/placement as a fallback.
retired_user.limits: The no-write callee contract does not assert a stable value for arbitrary surrounding uninitialized stack bits. Native/translated caller handling remains pending qualification.
